hadean: sky

sky
Meteors tear bright lines across a dim, hazy sky.
sky
The young Sun burns noticeably fainter than the one you know.
weather
The heat is furious, the whole world still cooling from a sea of magma.
air
The air is unbreathable: no oxygen at all, only carbon dioxide, nitrogen and volcanic steam.
smell
It smells of sulphur and hot stone.
sound

ground

ground
The crust is thin and unstable, split again and again by lava.
water

life

moment

moment
A distant fountain of lava throws sparks against the dark.

sky

air

weather

water

land

ground

sound

smell

life

life

air

weather

water

land

ground

sky

sound

life

moment

air

water

land

sky

smell

sound

life

life

weather

land

life

life

life

life

air

weather

land

life

life

land

moment

life

life

life

weather

ground

sound

air

life

land

life

weather

sound

life

life

air

water

weather

life
